evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 sensor is not installed; the required growth-atmosphere measurement is unavailable.
Pressure was 2.909 Torr near the end of the ramp at 100 sccm Ar.
Growth pressure has risen monotonically from 2.979 Torr at 2520 s to 3.249 Torr despite approximately constant Ar flow; no expected growth-pressure range is supplied.
Temperature is 749.8 C against 750 C setpoint, Ar is 99.6 sccm against 100 sccm, and status is running; these do not verify atmosphere composition.

args.missing_evidence: A validated exhaust O2 measurement is required to verify the growth atmosphere; expected growth-pressure limits or normal-run pressure data are needed to interpret the rising pressure. No sample characterization is available.
